_comment: Main vehicle data for powertrain.py. Values marked ASSUMPTION in 'notes' are ours: confirm with manufacturer data.

engine_map.note: source = 'measured' or 'model'. measured: steady-state test-bench map of a 13 L heavy-duty diesel engine (176 points, 2650 Nm, 405 kW, best BSFC 191 g/kWh = 44 %), provided by AB Volvo for the TRA545 course project; data/engine_map_measured.csv (written by import_engine_map.py from the Excel file). model: semi-empirical map scaled to a 50 % peak (assumption). If the measured file is missing the model map is used. ASSUMPTIONS with the measured map: test fuel LHV 42.7 MJ/kg (not stated in the file); same map for HVO100 and for the hydrogen engine (equal efficiency); buses use the map at equal BMEP, scaled by displacement; full-load curve still from the D13K540 fact sheet.

ishift_overdrive.source: Volvo I-Shift 12-speed, overdrive version (volgenpower.com). NOTE: 11th->12th step (1.51->0.78) looks odd, check

timber_truck.notes: Engine: Volvo D13K540 fact sheet. ASSUMPTIONS: axle ratio 3.10 and tyre radius 0.50 m (315/80R22.5) chosen so that 80 km/h in 12th gear = ~1320 rpm (Volvo economy band 950-1400); gearbox/axle efficiencies typical values; aux 4 kW from VECTO standard values (fan, steering, electric, pneumatic, AC). Crane PTO not in the driving cycle.

h2ice_mass.mass_note: Model H2 use ~31 kg per 200 km round trip (9.2 + 21.6 kg); 40 kg usable (A); MAN hTGX carries 56 kg (S: MAN_HTGX) = about +1050 kg system. Aftertreatment kept (MAN: simplified, not removed); HPDI pilot tank ignored (A). Used by powertrain.py in a second run for the hydrogen engine (diesel and HVO stay at the diesel mass).

urban_bus.notes: ASSUMPTIONS: 250 kW engine = the D13 map scaled by power (same BMEP map); city buses often use torque-converter automatics, I-Shift ratios used as a simplification; axle 4.70 so 50 km/h in 12th = ~1300 rpm; aux 8 kW incl. HVAC (JRC range).

h2ice_mass.mass_note: Storage term only; engine difference not confirmable (A = 0). Used by powertrain.py in a second run for the hydrogen engine (diesel and HVO stay at the diesel mass).

coach.notes: ASSUMPTIONS: 340 kW engine = D13 map scaled by power; axle 2.30 so 100 km/h in 12th = ~1220 rpm; aux 6 kW.

h2ice_mass.mass_note: Storage term only; engine difference not confirmable (A = 0). Used by powertrain.py in a second run for the hydrogen engine (diesel and HVO stay at the diesel mass).

timber_loaded.mass_note: max_gross_kg 74 t = Swedish BK4 limit, unchanged axle loads (S: Trafikverket, 'BK - barighetsklasser pa vagar och broar', https://bransch.trafikverket.se/for-dig-i-branschen/vag/bk--barighetsklasser-pa-vagar-och-broar/). No extra allowance for zero-emission vehicles above 74 t found (the EU +2 t of Reg. 2019/1242 applies to the international 40/44 t limits). The gross stays at 74 t for every powertrain and the extra powertrain mass reduces the payload. tare_kg = empty truck = timber_empty mass (A).

urban_bus.pax_note: BASE CASE = Swedish average occupancy (decision 13/10/2026: average for energy/LCA, full load only to check the powertrain). 12 passengers (S/D: Trafikanalys 'Regional linjetrafik 2024', ~10 passengers per bus-km, ~15 % of places). 68 kg = EU reference mass. curb 12 t = A. gvw_kg 19.5 t = Volvo 7900 Electric data sheet 2024 (S). Sources:  Trafikanalys 'Regional linjetrafik 2024' (bus ~15 % of places occupied, ~10 passengers per bus-km, derived from rounded shares); Miljobarometern/Trafikanalys 24.5 % of seats occupied in 2025 for subsidised public transport (bus + rail); Trafikanalys 'Langvaga buss 2010' Tab. 1 (long-distance coach: 52 seats, ~71 % load factor, ~37 pax per bus-km, derived); NEA for IRU 2007 'Research on the weight of buses and touring coaches' p.32 (measured 75.6 kg per passenger + 16.76 kg luggage on coaches; EU reference 68 kg, Dir. 97/27).

coach.pax_note: BASE CASE = Swedish average occupancy: 37 passengers (D: Trafikanalys 'Langvaga buss 2010', 52 seats, ~71 % load factor). 80 kg incl. luggage = A (measured 92.4 kg, NEA/IRU 2007). curb 14 t = A. gvw_kg 20.2 t = Volvo 9700 coach, 53 seats, steerable tag axle (S: volvobuses.com Volvo 9700 specifications).

urban_bus_heavyurban.note: Cycle sensitivity: same vehicle and load as urban_bus, VECTO Heavy Urban cycle.

urban_bus_suburban.note: Cycle sensitivity: same vehicle and load as urban_bus, VECTO Suburban cycle.

urban_bus_synthetic.note: Cycle sensitivity: same vehicle and load as urban_bus, synthetic 10 km line, 100 km (base case up to 0.2.1).

coach_synthetic.note: Cycle sensitivity: same vehicle and load as coach, synthetic 100 km intercity route (base case up to 0.2.1).

hpdi.note: AVL: 97.5 % H2 energy at full load. ASSUMPTION: constant pilot energy per cycle at a given speed.

electric._comment: Data for electric.py (FCEV and BEV). S = sourced, D = derived from sources, A = assumption, to be confirmed with manufacturer data. extra_mass_kg (per vehicle, for bev and fcev) adds mass on top of the mission mass: battery or hydrogen tanks minus the removed diesel powertrain. Values and arithmetic in mass_breakdown_kg, rules in mass_method, full references in mass_sources (research 13/10/2026).

edrive.note: Loss model per unit of motor peak power: p_loss = c0 + k_cu t^2 + k_fe w^1.5 + k_fw w^3 (t = torque/T_max, w = speed/base speed), shape scaled so the machine peak efficiency is 96.5 % (S: Grunditz & Thiringer 2017, Chalmers, reference PMSMs 96.4-97.1 %). Inverter coefficients, constant-power speed ratio, gear step, gear efficiency (97 % is the Grunditz single-speed value), regen cut-off speed and regen limit (0.20 g on the driven-axle load) are A. Stops: when braking to a standstill, the kinetic energy below the regeneration cut-off speed (1/2 m_eff v_cut^2) goes to the friction brakes (with 10 m steps the last braking step would otherwise stay above the cut-off).

battery.note: Internal-resistance model with constant voltage: loss = loss_at_1C * P^2 / P_1C (A, ECM parameters not available). Charger efficiency 90 % (S: Skogforsk Arbetsrapport 1176-2023).

fuel_cell.note: System efficiency (LHV) at 25 % and 100 % load BOL: S (DOE Program Record 26002, 2026); EOL at 25 % and 100 %: S (Wang & Ahluwalia, Argonne, 2025: 48-51 % peak, 40-48 % rated); other points interpolated (A). Purge and crossover are inside the efficiency; purge share 0.5 % (assumption) is reported separately only for the H2-emission inventory. Minimum load, ramp rate, DC/DC curve and EMS settings are A (not available from public sources). EMS priority when the battery cannot take more charge: 1) the fuel cell backs off to its minimum load (ramp limited), 2) regeneration is reduced (friction brakes), 3) the fuel cell goes below its minimum load only if still needed.

bev.mass_note: Battery 590 kWh / 0.146 kWh/kg = 4041 kg (3831-4275 kg at 154-138 Wh/kg). Previous value 2000 kg (A) assumed 256 Wh/kg, a cell-level figure.

fcev.mass_note: 40 kg H2 usable (A) = one 200 km round trip with an aged fuel cell (~32 kg in this model) + reserve. Storage mass scales ~23 kg per kg H2 at 700 bar: with 60 kg H2 the net value is about +750 kg.

timber_truck.note: Motor 490 kW peak (S: Volvo FH Electric). FC 2 x 150 kW (S: Volvo/cellcentric test trucks). Buffer battery 70 kWh, 400 kW peak (S: Mercedes GenH2; trade-press source, to be replaced with the Daimler Truck release): C_discharge 5.71 = 400/70. C_charge 3C = 210 kW is A (charge acceptance not stated); sensitivity C_charge 5C: H2 of the loaded leg -0.3 %. BEV battery 590 kWh installed (D: Skogforsk 2.5/1.5 kWh/km, 200 km round trip, 85 % window, 20 % reserve). 4 gears like the eActros 600 e-axle (S), ratios A. Driven-axle load share A.

bev.mass_note: HIGH UNCERTAINTY: no sourced mass for a 7-9 L bus diesel engine; D13 package scaled by displacement 8.1/12.8. Replace with the Volvo D8K fact sheet.

fcev.mass_note: 37.5 kg H2 in 5 x 350 bar cylinders (A): size it from the daily duty cycle. Cylinder mass only, valves/frames excluded.

urban_bus.note: Motor 250 kW = matched to the diesel engine so every powertrain can drive the same cycle (A; the Volvo 7900 Electric has 200 kW, S). 2-speed gearbox (S: Volvo 7900 Electric). Battery 330 kWh (Volvo 7900 Electric option, secondary source). FC 85 kW and 45 kWh buffer are A. Aux 8 kW electric incl. HVAC is A (Boren 2020 measured 0.28 kWh/km of heat from an HVO heater on Gothenburg route 55).

bev.mass_note: Coach diesel engine 11 L: D13 package scaled by displacement (A). Replace with the Volvo D11K fact sheet.

fcev.mass_note: 45 kg H2 at 350 bar (A). Cylinder mass only.

coach.note: All coach electric sizes are A (motor matched to the diesel engine; FC 180 kW like Hyundai XCIENT).

electric.mass_method: Net extra mass vs the diesel vehicle = added components - removed components (sum of mass_breakdown_kg, rounded to 10 kg). Rules used everywhere: battery pack 146 Wh/kg (midpoint of 138 [EACTROS600] and 154 [VOLVO_7900E], range used for bounds; ICCT_2021 assumes 140); fuel cell system 0.65 kW/kg [CELLCENTRIC] for trucks/coach, 0.28 kW/kg [BALLARD_FCMOVE] for the city bus; 700 bar storage system 4.32 wt% H2 (midpoint of 4.19-4.45 [DOE_SA_700BAR]); 350 bar = 101 kg per 7.5 kg H2 cylinder [HEXAGON_T4] + H2; removed diesel engine + aftertreatment 1225 kg for the D13 [VOLVO_D13], bus engines scaled by displacement (A, replace with Volvo D8K/D11K fact sheets); I-Shift 278 kg [VOLVO_ISHIFT] removed only for the timber truck (e-axle architecture like eActros 600, 4 gears); buses keep a gearbox (A, difference 0); e-drive (motors, inverters, e-axle, extra cooling) 300 kg = A, NOT confirmed by any source, sensitivity 0-600 kg; diesel fuel on board: truck 450 L, coach 400 L, city bus 250 L at 0.835 kg/L (A); hydrogen on board sized from the simulated consumption + reserve (A). Missions with max_gross_kg (timber_loaded) keep the gross mass at the limit: the extra mass reduces the payload (payload_kg in the summaries) instead of raising the simulated mass. mass_range_kg: pack 154/138 Wh/kg, e-drive 0/600 kg, I-Shift removed/kept (timber), scaled bus/coach engine mass +/-25 % (A); FCEV and H2-ICE ranges from the research synthesis (13/10/2026).

mass_sources.VOLVO_D13: Volvo Trucks, Fact sheet D13S540A (Euro 6, 397 kW), 16/06/2025, p.3: engine dry weight ~1105 kg, exhaust aftertreatment (DOC+DPF+SCR+ASC) ~120 kg. https://stpi.it.volvo.com/STPIFiles/Volvo/FactSheet/D13S540A_Eng_02_338836622.pdf
mass_sources.VOLVO_ISHIFT: Volvo Trucks, Fact sheet I-Shift AT2612 (without oil): 278 kg. https://stpi.it.volvo.com/STPIFiles/Volvo/FactSheet/AT2612_Eng_02_324367762.pdf
mass_sources.VOLVO_7900E: Volvo Buses, Data sheet Volvo 7900 Electric, BED 207465, 15/08/2024, p.1-2: NCA battery pack 94 kWh / 609 kg = 154 Wh/kg (pack level). https://www.volvobuses.com/content/dam/volvo-buses/markets/master/city-and-intercity/complete-buses/volvo-7900-electric/data-sheet-7900-electric-en-2024.pdf
mass_sources.EACTROS600: Daimler Truck press release, eActros 600 world premiere (2023): 3 x 207 kWh LFP packs; pack mass 1.5 t each (M. Wolf, Daimler R&D, quoted by electrive.com 10/10/2023) = 138 Wh/kg. SECONDARY SOURCE (trade press). https://www.electrive.com/2023/10/10/world-premiere-clear-the-stage-for-the-mercedes-benz-eactros-600/
mass_sources.ICCT_2021: Basma et al., ICCT Working Paper 2021-29 'Long-haul battery electric trucks are technically feasible in Europe' (2021) and slides (2022): pack density 0.14 kWh/kg (2020), 0.23 kWh/kg projected 2030. https://theicct.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Long-haul-be-trucks-EU-slides-02072022.pdf
mass_sources.CELLCENTRIC: cellcentric, press release IAA Transportation 2022: BZA150 fuel cell system 150 kW net, ~230 kg (0.65 kW/kg). https://cellcentric.net/en/cellcentric-iaa-transportation-2022/
mass_sources.BALLARD_FCMOVE: Ballard Power Systems, FCmove product page: FCmove-HD rated power 70 kW, weight 247 kg (0.28 kW/kg); used in the Solaris Urbino 12 hydrogen. URL to add (manufacturer product page, ballard.com).
mass_sources.DOE_SA_700BAR: Strategic Analysis for US DOE, 'Final Report: Hydrogen Storage System Cost Analysis (2017-2021)', OSTI 1975554: Class 8 truck, 700 bar Type IV, complete system (tanks + BOP) 4.19-4.45 wt% H2. https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1975554
mass_sources.HEXAGON_T4: Hexagon Purus, 'Hydrogen Type 4 cylinder information' (rev. 05/22, 08/22): 350 bar cylinder H2-35-430X3190 = 101 kg empty, 312 L, 7.5 kg H2 (cylinder only, BOP excluded). https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/hexagonassets/HPU_0222_04_HydrogenType4_NurTabelle.pdf
mass_sources.MAN_HTGX: MAN Truck & Bus press material 2025 (hTGX): 56 kg H2 at 700 bar in 4 tanks (Voith module); H45 engine based on the D38 diesel; MAN Engines: hydrogen engine derived from the D3876 shares about 80 % of basic components. https://press.mantruckandbus.com/corporate/iaa-commercial-vehicles-man-honoured-with-truck-innovation-award-2025/ ; https://vision-mobility.de/en/news/man-plans-hydrogen-combustion-engine-htgx-317819.html

power_to_mass_rule.rule: Every powertrain has the same wheel power-to-mass ratio [kW/t] as the diesel reference on each mission, so all of them can follow the same driving cycle (a ~ P / (m v)). The current rule 'electric motor = diesel engine power' no longer holds once the mass penalty is included. Base case with Swedish average occupancy (12 / 37 passengers): BEV city bus 60 steps above the motor limit, BEV coach 154, H2-ICE city bus 17, H2-ICE coach 5; with 40 passengers on the city bus: BEV 294 steps (5-7 % above the limit), H2-ICE 205. Missing energy < 0.5 %.
power_to_mass_rule.test_13_10_2026: Motor 250 -> 270 kW (urban bus) and 340 -> 370 kW (coach): BEV deficit steps -> 0, consumption +1.0 % / +1.3 % (larger motor at lower relative load, lower part-load efficiency); FCEV +0.4 % / +0.9 % with the same motor. Real reference: Volvo 7900 Electric has 200 kW and runs urban lines by accelerating less than this cycle (~0.8 m/s2 at 45 km/h instead of 1.0). (Test done with 40 passengers on the city bus.)
power_to_mass_rule.note: wheel_kW: diesel/H2-ICE = (rated - aux) x gearbox x axle x 0.97 (as missions.py p_wheel_max); electric = motor peak x gear x axle. timber_loaded: the gross mass is capped at 74 t for every powertrain, so kW/t depends only on the installed power.
